text: I'm not sure if this is the right number but I'm looking after my nephew, he's 20 months. About half an hour ago he had what I think was a fit, he went all stiff and his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes rolled back, lasted maybe a minute? He's never done that before ever. Now he won't put his head down, I tried getting him to look at his tummy and he just won't bend his neck forward, seems stiff or it hurts him maybe. His colour's normal, lips look fine, not blue or anything. I'm so exhausted I can't think straight, his mum is on her way back
